simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שִׁלְטוֹן (H7984) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) or שִׁלְטֹן lemma שִׁלְטן missing vowel, corrected to שִׁלְטֹן ; corresponding to 7983
